scope: Only existing canonical Poaceae taxonomy name/rank/synonym/identity/hybrid holds. No species-card, photo, lesson, installation, county-native, Pages or unrelated work.

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts the existing Poaceae species at species rank; 1933 combination and authorship match canonical learner.
POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts as separate species, not a variety of B. hirsuta; 1931 authorship matches canonical learner.
POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts this as a separate species from B. pectinata and B. rigidiseta.
Homotypic synonym (1854 basionym); do not install an independent Aegopogon card.
Heterotypic synonym under accepted B. rigidiseta; retain original author as historical alias.
Heterotypic synonym under accepted B. rigidiseta; name is not a separate species concept for new installation.
POWO synonymizes the 1996 species-rank combination with B. rigidiseta. Historical species-rank identification is not independent voucher proof.
POWO places the 1982 varietal name under accepted B. rigidiseta at species rank; retain original rank in source alias.
POWO lists this as a homotypic synonym of B. pectinata, not accepted B. hirsuta; historical varietal placement must not collapse species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Bouteloua hirsuta subsp. pectinata (Feath.) Wipff & S.D.Jones
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO lists 1996 subspecies combination as homotypic synonym of separately accepted B. pectinata.
POWO lists the 1982 generic transfer as a homotypic synonym of B. pectinata.
POWO lists the 2012 combination as homotypic synonym of B. pectinata, while explicitly noting that no basionym was cited; retain that nomenclatural qualification.
POWO assigns historical 'major' variety (1890) to B. pectinata, not to accepted B. hirsuta.
POWO assigns this historical 1894 variety to B. pectinata; do not confuse with B. hirta var. minor.
POWO retains the historical 'minor' variety within B. hirsuta synonymy, unlike var. major which maps to B. pectinata.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed automatic merge of Bouteloua hirsuta var. pectinata and var. major into accepted Bouteloua hirsuta
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO maps both historical names to accepted B. pectinata. FAIL applies to the proposed mapping, not the accepted B. hirsuta species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Source vouchers or images labelled Bouteloua chihuahuana / B. rigidiseta var. chihuahuana
scientific_decisions.reason: Although current POWO maps the names to B. rigidiseta, a historical segregate concept cannot certify an individual specimen/photo without morphology and provenance.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual learner photographs for B. rigidiseta, B. pectinata and B. hirsuta
scientific_decisions.reason: The canonical species files retain photo gaps and provisional identification issues. This name review does not inspect image pixels or verify exact photographed organs.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Putative Bouteloua hirsuta × Bouteloua pectinata hybrid specimens
scientific_decisions.reason: USFS FEIS reports hybridization between hairy and tall grama, but no individual learner photo or voucher was genotyped or proven hybrid. No formula or new hybrid card is authorized.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical broad Bouteloua hirsuta var. pectinata/major voucher identifications
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO accepted-name destination is clear (B. pectinata), but unvouchered historical records using a broad hairy-grama concept cannot be individually reassigned without source material; some secondary floras still describe pectinata at variety rank.

key_concept_guardrails: Accepted B. pectinata is distinct from accepted B. hirsuta; historical B. hirsuta var./subsp. pectinata and var. major map to B. pectinata.
Historical B. hirsuta var. minor maps to B. hirsuta, not B. pectinata; major versus minor is not interchangeable.
B. chihuahuana and B. rigidiseta var. chihuahuana map to accepted B. rigidiseta, but historic specimen identifications remain unverified.
USFS reports hybridization between B. hirsuta and B. pectinata; no photographed individual is proven hybrid.
limitations: POWO/WCVP accepted-name and synonym records were verified; original protologues for all historical names were not independently inspected.
Historical variety/species voucher identities and actual photographed plants remain HOLD/UNRESOLVED where indicated.
No hybrid parentage assigned to individual records; no new hybrid accepted-name assertion.
Canonicals and any existing taxonomic/photo/range holds remain unchanged.
